skills.name: Best Friends Forever
skills.description: Takeru and Patamon high five. Good effects on allies.  *Skill Evade Rate +40% (10 sec) *Evade Rate +30% (10 sec) *Skill Resistance +35% (10 sec)

skills.name: Air Shot
skills.description: Takes a deep breath and fires an air ball. Bad effects on enemies.  *ATK x 3000% Area Damage  *Enemy knockback  *Enemy Skill Evade Rate -60% (7 sec)

abilities.name: Group: Digimon Adventure
abilities.description: Digimon Adventure Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and ATK buffs will be applied in battle. You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Revive
abilities.description: Rangers will have a high chance of being revived when they are defeated. Rangers will be revived with 70% HP. This Ability will only activate once.
